title: Brazier of Souls
wikitext:
[[Image:BrazierOfSouls.png|right|160px]]
'''Brazier of Souls''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Magical weapon]]

'''Any Phase''': Exhaust before making a [[Combat check]] to gain +8 to that check.

'''Upkeep''': Brazier of the Souls only refreshes if you spend all of your [[Focus]] to do so.

'''Hands''': 2

'''Price''': $7
